The [published answer archive](https://index.broadcastwell.com/data/php2shell/study/study-answers.jsonl) makes one limit inspectable. Two Google AI Mode answers to the opening fix question on 23 October 2026 have different `answer_text` but both list `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BAoKuAB2h_E` in `cited_urls`. Their saved fields include the answer, URLs and capture status; they contain no transcript, caption text or consumed-source passage. Those particular records establish repeated attachment of a video-page URL. They cannot identify whether either answer consumed a transcript, much less whether a transcript changed the citation outcome.
